claim: The largest Fargate task size on Amazon ECS is 32768 CPU units (32 vCPU) with 60 GB, 120 GB or 244 GB of memory. It runs on Linux only and needs Linux platform 1.4.0 or later.
question: What is the largest CPU and memory combination for an ECS task on Fargate?
note: Changed 2026-06-05: the largest size was 16 vCPU before the 32 vCPU option (see ecs-change-fargate-32vcpu-2026-06 and ecs-change-fargate-new-task-sizes-2022-09). A writer labels it Changed recently.
